rowText: Ask a parent question that gets no close match ("How do I beat Megaera?"), then in the same chat ask a follow-up naming something new ("what about theseus and asterius"). Read Show details on the follow-up's reply; pass when the reply matches the follow-up's own note, and retrieval shows a fresh line, not a repeat of the parent's.
verdictSentence: Not reached. This needs the Megaera question sent first, and that never went through tonight -- see plan61-MEGAERA-01-retry2.json for the full account of why (the pinned-question box stopped offering that sentence partway through the session and never came back).
notes: The follow-up sentence ('what about theseus and asterius') was never reached either, for the same reason.
